name: How much does duplex construction cost in Los Angeles per square foot?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost per square foot to build a duplex in Los Angeles or nearby cities?
mainEntity.text: What is the typical cost per square foot to build a duplex in Los Angeles or nearby cities?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost per square foot is only useful when the site and finish level are defined, because duplex projects in Los Angeles can swing sharply based on lot slope, demolition, access, foundation type, parking requirements, and the quality of interior finishes. A straightforward project on a flat lot will usually cost less than a custom luxury duplex in a dense neighborhood or hillside setting. The budget should also include architecture, engineering, surveys, plan check fees, school or utility-related charges where applicable, temporary protection, and a contingency for unknown conditions. Owners often underestimate soft costs and utility upgrades, which can materially change the true per-square-foot number. A better budgeting method is to estimate by scope: site work, shell, MEP systems, interiors, permitting, and contingency. For decision-making, compare at least two scenarios, such as a standard rental-grade build and a higher-end owner-user or investor product, so the financial target matches the intended use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Duplex construction costs in Los Angeles vary widely based on design level, site conditions, and finishes. Simple builds can land in a lower range, while luxury duplexes with difficult access, hillside work, or custom details cost significantly more per square foot. The total budget should include design, permits, utility upgrades, and contingency, not just hard construction.
